home_hero_alpha: Warning under the download buttons that Atlas is alpha software; the link opens a new GitHub issue.
home_hero_clip_alt: Alt text of the product video beside the h1 (the agents dashboard).
home_hero_fine: Small print under the download buttons. {platforms} is the list of operating systems formatted for the language (macOS, Windows and Linux).
home_hero_lead: Paragraph under the h1 on wide screens: what Atlas is and what it does, in plain words for people who are not specialists.
home_hero_lead_short: Shorter line under the h1 on phones (replaces the long paragraph).
home_hero_meta_description: Meta description of the home page (search results and link previews), about 160 characters.
home_hero_meta_title: <title> and og:title of the home page.
home_hero_play_film: Label of the button that opens the product film, shown before JavaScript loads; the film's length follows it.
home_hero_title: The h1 of the home page: the whole promise of Atlas in one line. Two short sentences.
